ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity pixels; macro-ratio approximately 5:95 (white-to-black) across the total fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel block across >90% of visible surface. High-intensity (white) localized clusters detected at distal tips and sparse linear patterns across both lobe faces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch; calculated interior angle approximately 40-45 degrees; high vertical depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated trailing edge with high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel variations (1-5 pixels). Distinct larger jagged peaks localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep from the central notch toward the tips; leading edges exhibit a convex trajectory emerging from the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the far-left and far-right distal tips; additional sparse white circular flecks scattered on the medial regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct high-contrast linear disruptions. Notable diagonal mark (approx 45-degree angle) on the right lobe. Several smaller vertical and horizontal white linear marks across the central and left fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible white linear rake marks across both lobe surfaces; heavy white scarring or calcification at distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct small semi-circular notch or indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately two-thirds of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
